plan.title: Reopen Line Items Disabled Before Expiry

steps.note: Open the prepared staggered auction in the buyer portal before any line has expired.
Enable lot scheduling and split auctions required for staggered line items.
Open the event Settings menu containing Reopen Line Items.
Assert Reopen Line Items is disabled and its tooltip explains that line items can only be reopened after at least one has expired.
